set.body:
R/fmri_lm_runwise.R:545 and :559 build robust_weights_list via

  lapply(XtXinv_list, function(x) attr(x, "robust_weights"))

but that attribute is never set anywhere in the package - XtWXi_final is just
proj_w$XtXinv (R/fmri_robust_fitting.R:154) and carries only rank attributes. So the
list is all NULL and the robust effective-df adjustment is silently skipped.

Compounding it: the sequential branch (:500-514) never captures
robust_fit$robust_weights_final at all, and the parallel branch returns it (:442)
but the collection loop (:463-471) never reads it.

Affects the voxelwise AR + robust path only. Fix: capture the weights in both
branches and thread them through, or drop the dead lookup and the df adjustment
that depends on it.
set.title: Bug: robust_weights_list is always NULL; robust effective-df adjustment silently skipped
